description: Gzip budgets in bytes, read only by scripts/bundle-size.mjs (npm run size). Sizes are esbuild minified, gzip level 9, react and react-native external. Raise a budget only with a reason in the PR; lowering one is always allowed. Budgets are the measured baseline plus about 10 percent headroom.

./native/expo.note: no source yet; add entry and budget when src/native/expo exists

./adapters/*.note: no source yet; add entry and budget when src/adapters exists

./testing.note: no source yet; add entry and budget when src/testing exists

./meta.note: no public entry yet (src/meta has types only); add entry and budget when src/meta/index.ts exists

./package.json.note: metadata file, not a code bundle
